description: This file defines the AppUser class representing a user with roles and serialization methods, along with an enum for user roles.

classes.name: AppUser
classes.description: Represents an application user with properties like id, email, name, role, avatarUrl, and token, along with serialization methods.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enum defining user roles: nurse and hospital.

methods.name: AppUser.fromMap
methods.description: Creates an AppUser instance from a map, parsing role and other fields.

methods.name: AppUser.toMap
methods.description: Converts the AppUser instance into a Map for serialization.

methods.name: AppUser.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the AppUser instance into a JSON string.

methods.name: AppUser.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AppUser instance from a JSON string.
